prompt:
A wide establishing vista of Beijing in a high-fantasy world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: a radiant imperial capital of a Chinese myth-world at a golden dawn: along one long, straight axis a vast palace city of vermilion walls and sweeping roofs of golden glazed tile rising hall after hall on white marble terraces with carved balustrades, a curving golden stream crossed by white arched bridges; to the south a round hall with three tiers of deep-blue glazed roofs on a triple white marble terrace, glowing softly; to the north-west a lake with a long painted corridor along its shore and a hill crowned with a tiered tower; on the far mountain ridges a long crenellated wall winding from watchtower to watchtower; silk lanterns and drifting cloud-shaped lights in the air.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Avoid: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
